entry.title: MPC Gateway 1.0.0
entry.summary: One HTTPS front door with one password (Caddy) for the web services addins declare: a start page that lists them, and a route or port for each. Device only by default; reach it through an SSH tunnel, or open it with bind=0.0.0.0. ## Requirements - A Gen2 MPC OS standalone device (aarch64: Live III, One G2, Key(s) G2). The installer refuses anything else. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Installing addins this way is unofficia
